title: Query Insights
description: OpenSearch Query Insights (Top-N queries by latency). The top_queries-* indices are written by the query-insights plugin: each doc is one sampled query carrying its latency (measurements.latency.number, ms), CPU (measurements.cpu.number, ns) and memory (measurements.memory.number, bytes) plus the target indices and per-phase timings. Sampled top-N only — not the full query stream, so volume numbers are the sampler's capture count, not total cluster queries.
